blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—The University of the East Pep Squad has consistently come up short of a podium finish in three of the last four editions of the UAAP Cheerdance Competition. That fact alone fueled the squad to match its best finish and end its medal drought on Saturday night at Mall of Asia Arena. “We’re still very overwhelmed with what happened,” said coach Gibson Alegre, whose crew finished fourth in Seasons 85, 87 and 88. “For the past few years, we fell short. We even set expectations because we’re always heartbroken, but when we heard that announcement, we felt like we were […]...
